about: Failed-print guide for the Kobra S1 (enclosed CoreXY, direct drive, Rinkhals/Klipper, ACE Pro) with Print Lab's OrcaSlicer profiles. Symptom list modelled on the Print Diagnosis tool at rapidelevation.com/diagnosis.html; causes are ordered most likely first for this printer. Profile numbers: PLA 205 C (215 C first layer) on 0.4, 220 C on 0.8, bed 55 C / 60 C, retraction 0.8 mm at 40 mm/s, flow cap 12 mm3/s, pressure advance 0.035 / 0.03, fan 100% from layer 2.

causes.check: Fingerprints or a shiny patch where earlier prints sat.
causes.fix: Wash the plate with dish soap and warm water, then dry it; wipe with 90%+ IPA between prints. Don't touch the print area.

causes.check: First-layer lines are round with gaps between them instead of slightly flattened.
causes.fix: Lower Z offset 0.02 mm at a time on the touchscreen (or in Fluidd) during the first layer until the lines just touch.

causes.cause: Bed too cool for the part
causes.check: Large flat parts lift at the corners; small ones are fine.
causes.fix: Send 'bed 65' to the bot before the next job (PLA), or 80 for PETG. 'bed normal' undoes it.

causes.check: Lines are thin or dragged at corners.
causes.fix: Send 'first 225' to the bot for a hotter first layer; the high-quality preset also slows things down.

causes.check: Tall thin parts, or parts standing on a point or edge.
causes.fix: Re-orient onto a larger flat face, or add a brim (ask Claude to re-slice with one).

causes.check: Only with non-PLA, worse on long parts.
causes.fix: Keep the enclosure shut, let the chamber warm up for 10 minutes before printing, and lower part cooling for ABS/ASA.

causes.cause: Bed too cool or adhesion weak
causes.check: Corners lift in the first few millimetres.
causes.fix: Raise the bed 5-10 C ('bed 65') and clean the plate; add a brim or mouse ears.

causes.cause: Draft through an open door or lid
causes.check: One side lifts more than the others.
causes.fix: Close the enclosure; keep the printer away from fans and open windows.

causes.cause: Sharp corners on large flat parts
causes.check: Lifting starts at 90-degree corners.
causes.fix: Brim, or fillet the corners in the model.

causes.check: The kept camera frames (/frames) show when it moved.
causes.fix: Fix adhesion first (see 'Won't stick'); add a brim for tall or small-footprint parts.

causes.cause: Curled overhang hit by the nozzle
causes.check: Failure starts at an overhang or bridge; edges curl up before it goes.
causes.fix: Add supports or re-orient; keep the fan at 100% for PLA (z-hop is already 0.4 mm).

causes.check: Part snapped or bent near the base.
causes.fix: Brim, print several together, or slow down with the high-quality preset.

causes.check: Strands thin out before the mess starts.
causes.fix: See 'Gaps / under-extrusion' and 'Clicking extruder'.

causes.check: Worse on fast infill and with the 0.8 nozzle; walls fine, infill sparse.
causes.fix: The profiles cap flow at 12 mm3/s; on the 0.8 use medium or high, or run PLA 5-10 C hotter.

causes.check: Thin or uneven lines everywhere, not just at speed.
causes.fix: Cold pull: heat to 210 C, push filament by hand, cool to about 90 C, pull hard. Repeat until the tip comes out clean.

causes.check: Gaps come and go; a spool sticks or the tube is kinked.
causes.fix: Check the spool turns freely and the PTFE path is smooth; re-seat the hub connectors.

causes.check: Crackling or popping while printing, rough surface, steam at the nozzle.
causes.fix: Dry it (PLA 50 C, PETG 65 C, 6 h) and store it with desiccant.

causes.check: The slice was for a different nozzle than the one fitted.
causes.fix: Set the right nozzle on the touchscreen; Print Lab reads it before every slice.

causes.check: Filament won't push through by hand at temperature.
causes.fix: Cold pull; if that fails, swap the nozzle.

causes.check: Clicks only on infill or fast moves.
causes.fix: 5-10 C hotter, or a slower preset.

causes.check: Long PLA prints in a hot closed enclosure; jams after hours.
causes.fix: For PLA, crack the lid open; keep the hotend fan and heatsink free of dust.

causes.check: Grooves or dust on the filament at the extruder.
causes.fix: Cut back past the damage, reload, and brush the drive gear clean.

causes.check: Strings plus popping and fuzz; worse with PETG and TPU.
causes.fix: Dry it. This fixes most stringing on this printer.

causes.check: Strings thin out as a temperature tower gets cooler.
causes.fix: Drop 5-10 C, or ask Claude for a temperature tower.

causes.check: Profile retraction is 0.8 mm; strings are thick and regular.
causes.fix: Try 1.0-1.2 mm; direct drive rarely needs more than 2 mm.

causes.check: Material is PETG.
causes.fix: Run cooler (230-235 C) and dry it; a quick pass with a heat gun cleans off light wisps.

causes.check: Small craters spread across the surface.
causes.fix: Dry it.

causes.check: Bumps line up in one vertical line.
causes.fix: The profile uses an aligned seam; ask for a rear or random seam when re-slicing.

causes.cause: Pressure advance off for this filament
causes.check: Blobs at line starts, thin ends at corners.
causes.fix: PA is 0.035 (0.4) / 0.03 (0.8); a PA test print tunes it per filament.

causes.check: General ooze and a glossy surface.
causes.fix: Drop 5 C.

causes.check: Shift right after an overhang, or a scuffed top.
causes.fix: Supports or re-orient (z-hop is on).

causes.check: A cable, loose part or the ACE tube snagged.
causes.fix: With the printer off, move the head through its full travel; route tubes clear.

causes.check: Shifts in one axis, repeatable.
causes.fix: Check belt tension, then re-run the printer's input shaping calibration.

causes.cause: Acceleration too high for the part
causes.check: Heavy or tall prints shift at the same height.
causes.fix: High-quality preset, or ask for lower acceleration.

causes.check: Layers peel apart by hand.
causes.fix: Raise nozzle temp 5-10 C.

causes.check: Cracks on tall parts.
causes.fix: Lower part cooling and keep the enclosure closed.

causes.cause: Layer too thick for the nozzle
causes.check: Layer height over about 75% of the nozzle size.
causes.fix: At most 0.3 mm on the 0.4 nozzle, 0.6 mm on the 0.8.

causes.check: Thin, uneven layers.
causes.fix: See 'Gaps / under-extrusion'.

causes.check: Pillowing; infill shows through. The 0.8 medium profile has only 3.
causes.fix: High-quality preset (6 top layers), or ask for more top layers.

causes.cause: Infill too sparse under a big flat top
causes.check: 15% default; sagging between infill lines.
causes.fix: 20-25% infill, or gyroid.

causes.check: Ripples on the last layer.
causes.fix: High-quality preset (PLA fan is already 100%).

causes.check: Ridges and a shiny, lumpy top.
causes.fix: Lower the flow ratio slightly; a flow calibration print sets it per filament.

causes.check: First layer is see-through thin or rough.
causes.fix: Raise Z offset 0.02 mm at a time.

causes.check: The bottom few layers bulge, not just the first.
causes.fix: Back to the normal bed temperature ('bed normal').

causes.check: Profiles use 0.075 mm (0.4) / 0.1 mm (0.8).
causes.fix: Ask for 0.15-0.2 mm when parts must fit together.

causes.check: Ripples after corners; the printer was moved or belts changed.
causes.fix: Re-run input shaping / resonance calibration from the touchscreen.

causes.check: The table shakes on fast moves.
causes.fix: A heavy, stiff surface, ideally against a wall.

causes.cause: Too fast for a display part
causes.check: Visible on outer walls.
causes.fix: High-quality preset (outer walls 30 mm/s).

causes.check: Ringing plus shifts or a slack belt.
causes.fix: Re-tension, then re-run input shaping.

causes.cause: Filament ran out or an ACE swap failed
causes.check: Error on the touchscreen; spool empty or tangled.
causes.fix: Reload and resume from the touchscreen if it offers it.

causes.check: Feed or unload error (last time it was a loose tracker plug).
causes.fix: Re-seat the ACE cable and the tracker plug; check the hub.

causes.check: Thermal runaway or heating-failed error.
causes.fix: Check the hotend connector and wiring; don't keep retrying a heater error.

causes.cause: Print Lab or the bot stopped it
causes.check: The failure score was high; see /frames and the bot chat.
causes.fix: Check the frames; if it was a false alarm, tell Claude so the detector can be tuned.

causes.check: Fails at the same point every time.
causes.fix: Re-slice and send it again.
